name: Cadence Fitness
description: Cadence, a fitness and vitals app's landing page on a green-black ground: an Inter Black headline ringed by drifting activity pills, a paragraph that lights up word by word, vitals and progress bentos drawn as live app UI (heart rate, HRV, sleep debt, training load, VO2 max), a Linen Mist chapter that rises over the night, honest pricing, a wall of reviews and a Forest Ink closing band. Forest Ink, Spruce and one Lime Voltage accent; pill buttons, flat hairline surfaces.
designedFor: Launching a fitness tracker, wearable or health app
Product pages that show vitals and charts drawn in HTML rather than screenshots
Dark, confident marketing sites with block-letter headlines and scroll-driven storytelling
Teams who want every chart, pill and panel editable from the canvas editor
